description: Stateless insurance math: given an allowed amount and a plan snapshot (deductible, coinsurance, OOP max), returns exact patient responsibility, plan payment, and the breakdown, plus p25/p75 scenarios. Use when you already have a dollar amount (e.g. from an EOB or a prior estimate).

coinsurance.description: Coinsurance as a fraction, e.g. 0.2 for 20%

copay.description: Flat copay, if the plan uses one

preventive_exception.description: True if ACA preventive $0 cost-sharing applies

name: calculate_liability
